14: “…from the earth…” (Bereshit 2:7) R’ Berachiya and R’ Chelbo said in the name of R’ Shmuel bar Nachman: he was created from the place of his atonement. This is what it says “An altar of earth you shall make for Me…” (Shemot 20:21) The Holy One said: behold, I am creating him from the place of his atonement, oh that he stands! “He breathed into his nostrils…” (Bereshit 2:7) This comes to teach that He stood him up as a lifeless form that stretched from the land to the heavens and then threw a soul into him. Since in this world it was with the act of blowing, therefore we die, but in the future it will be given as it says “And I will put My spirit into you, and you shall live…” (Ezekiel 37:14)
